description: "History of the United Netherlands from the Death of William the Silent to the Twelve Year's Truce" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account written during the late 19th century. The book narrates the events in the Netherlands and the geopolitical maneuvering involved from the death of William the Silent through to the Twelve Years' Truce, focusing primarily on the intricate relationship between England, France, and the Dutch Provinces during this tumultuous period.
